text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to prohibit westbound left turns at all times from Covington Road into the Lawrence Plaza's driveway on the south side of the street, west of Bathurst Street. This prohibition will address the safety and operational concerns resulting from motorists turning into the driveway, due to the short spacing to the signalized intersection with Bathurst Street. The proposed turn prohibition will have an impact on the patrons and deliveries of the businesses located in the northeast portion of the Lawrence Plaza.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited westbound left-turn movements to the driveway of 3128-3130 Bathurst Street from Covington Road at all times.
